headline: PURCHASE INTENT NEEDS A MEDIAN 47 SECONDS OF ATTENTION ADDED UP ACROSS EVERY AD A PERSON SEES, AND A QUARTER OF THE HIGHEST-ATTENTION CAMPAIGNS MOVED IT NOT AT ALL
deck: Lumen Research published this yesterday with Amazon Ads and Cint across 270 cross-media campaigns.  The headline number is a threshold, which is new.  The two numbers underneath it are the ones that change how you cut and schedule a piece of video, and neither of them appears on Lumen's own page.
tldr: Purchase intent needs a median 47 seconds of attention added up across every ad a person actually looked at, several short views beat one long continuous view by 21 percent on sales lift, and a quarter of the highest-attention campaigns moved purchase intent by nothing at all.  Write down how many seconds of looking your next campaign is trying to buy per person, brief a short-exposures version against your current long placement, and ask any seller quoting 47 seconds whether that is per person or per campaign.

Meta held the creative and the creator roster still and moved only the share of assets running from creator accounts, and the cell at 30 percent or more cost 45 percent less per caused sale, with 63 percent of that reach landing on people the brand had not reached.  Count what share of your paid social assets currently run from a creator's account, brief your next flight to 30 percent, and measure it with a holdout you control rather than inside the platform's own tools.

RTL put 200 old episodes of a 1990s police series on YouTube, did more than 30 million views and double-digit millions in extra revenue, and YouTube used the same week to say it does not want to produce content itself.  List everything your company has filmed and published exactly once, put a clearance status beside each line, and schedule the three with the most existing demand as a series.

Brands sent 1.5 million samples into TikTok Shop and only 47 percent of them produced a video at all, which means the true cost of one video is about two samples rather than one, and the 74 dollars per video figure describes the creators who were already converting.  Ask every seeding partner for their post rate before you agree a volume, price per video produced rather than per sample sent, and move the budget line into your sales number with a cost-per-sale target.

YouTube surveyed over 20,000 EU creators, published 8.4 billion euros of GDP contribution and 83 percent saying recommendations are vital to their revenue, and spent all of it asking Brussels not to impose rules about what platforms must recommend.  Ask your European creator partners for the split between recommended views and subscriber or direct views on their last ten videos, and file it next to their rate as a risk note.

From 21 October YouTube opens the homepage Masthead to certified online gambling advertisers after five years of exclusion, on a reserved placement whose inventory cannot expand.  Confirm any November or December Masthead rate in writing before 21 October, and decide this week whether your brand safety policy has a position on gambling adjacency on the homepage.

BLAST Slam VIII set a real record — peak up 7.3 percent, hours up 2.1, on a flat 48 channels — while ESL Pro League's larger total came off nearly 230 channels, one co-streamer carrying 3.34 million hours alone and another counted twice across two platforms.  Ask for peak concurrents, average concurrents and the channel count including co-streams on every live proposal, then ask what you are buying on the official broadcast alone.

**1.** Purchase intent needs a median 47 seconds of attention added up across every ad a person actually looked at, several short views beat one long continuous view by 21 percent on sales lift, and a quarter of the highest-attention campaigns moved purchase intent by nothing at all.  Write down how many seconds of looking your next campaign is trying to buy per person, brief a short-exposures version against your current long placement, and ask any seller quoting 47 seconds whether that is per person or per campaign.
